_meta.WARNING_templates: USE THE FRESH BLANKS from tdlr.texas.gov (assets/). The PDFs originally supplied to this project had been opened in an editor and were mangled three ways: (1) residual test values, including /General Partnership and Renewal pre-ticked; (2) the /Sig signature fields STRIPPED; (3) the /DR font resource STRIPPED. Never source a template from an edited copy. Regardless: the fill routine MUST zero every field before writing (CLAUDE.md D7).
_meta.packet_math: N convictions => 1 x ENF006 (carries conviction #1) + (N-1) x ENF003
_meta.flatten: Flatten on output. Text is burned into the page -> identical on every printer.
_meta.signature_fields: BOTH forms carry a /Sig (cryptographic digital signature) field, and the AcroForm sets /SigFlags 1. NEVER POPULATE THEM. Invariant L6: the user signs in wet ink; liability transfers at physical execution. form.flatten() has been smoke-tested with /Sig present and works.
_meta.pdf_lib_call_syntax: GROUND TRUTH vs API SYNTAX. This map stores the TRUE PDF export value, WITH the leading slash ('/Choice3', '/Male', '/No') -- that is literally what is inside the PDF. BUT pdf-lib's PDFRadioGroup.select() wants the BARE name: select('Choice3'), NOT select('/Choice3'). Passing the slash THROWS. Route every tick through ONE helper that strips the slash, asserts the value exists on that field, selects it, and reads it back. The map stays true; the adapter absorbs the quirk. (Verified in the browser, Phase 0.)
_meta.OFF_IS_NOT_AN_OPTION: CRITICAL. /Off is the ABSENCE of a selection, not a selectable option. It does NOT appear in a radio group's option list. Calling select('Off') THROWS. To leave a group unselected you must CLEAR it (or never touch it) -- never 'select /Off'. Build clearButton() as a DISTINCT primitive from tickButton(). This bites hardest on 'Type of Ownership', where the non-business-owner case is BOTH the default AND the common one -- get it wrong and you ship a pre-ticked General Partnership.
_meta.GROUND_TRUTH_WARNING: The parole and probation export values in this file were WRONG until 2026-07-14, and were labelled 'VERIFIED', which made every downstream reader trust them MORE. A confident wrong answer in the ground-truth layer is worse than no answer -- nothing downstream can detect it, and every test written from it confirms it. If you ever need to check a claim in this file, do not read the field NAME or the export NUMBER. Read the WIDGET RECTANGLES: on these forms, 'No' is the LEFT box and 'Yes' is the RIGHT box. Geometry is the only ground truth independent of us being right.

business_branch._note: Hidden in UI unless the user is a controlling person of a company. When hidden, write 'N/A' to the text fields (no blanks allowed, F6) and leave Type of Ownership at /Off.

ownership_type.NOT_A_BUSINESS_OWNER: Leave this group UNSELECTED. Use clearButton(), or never touch it. There is NO '/Off' option on this field -- select('Off') THROWS. (An earlier revision of this map listed "none": "/Off". That was WRONG. Caught in the Phase 0 browser probe.)

conviction_1._TRAP: The field NAMED 'County and State of conviction or deferred adjudication' holds the COUNTY ONLY. The state goes in the separate field 'State (ex: Texas)'. Writing 'Harris, Texas' into the first field is WRONG and leaves the second blank.

on_parole.WARNING: /Choice1 means YES on #17 and NO on #16 -- same form, same value, opposite meanings. THE NUMBER CARRIES NO MEANING. Never reason from it. If you are checking the map itself, read the widget geometry.
on_parole.CORRECTED_2026_07_14: THIS WAS INVERTED. The previous revision said no=/Choice1, yes=/Choice3. It was WRONG, and it generated packets telling TDLR that a man who is NOT on parole IS on parole. Verified by WIDGET GEOMETRY against the real blank: on the printed form 'No' is the LEFT box and 'Yes' is the RIGHT box. #17 widgets: x=192 -> /Choice3 (NO), x=226 -> /Choice1 (YES). Every automated test passed on the wrong value, because the tests were written FROM it. ONLY PRINTING THE PAGE CAUGHT IT.
